import sqlite3
import requests

def _fetch_run_summary(conn, run_id):
    # Read the run's name and metric count before deletion (read-only)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT name FROM runs WHERE id = ?', (run_id,)).fetchone()
    count = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metrics WHERE run_id = ?', (run_id,)).fetchone()[0]
    return {'name': row[0] if row else None, 'metric_count': count}

def purge_run_and_notify_webhook(run_id, webhook_url):
    with sqlite3.connect('tracking.db') as conn:
        summary = _fetch_run_summary(conn, run_id)
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM metrics WHERE run_id = ?', (run_id,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM runs WHERE id = ?', (run_id,))
    resp = requests.post(webhook_url, json={'event': 'run_deleted', 'run_id': run_id, 'summary': summary}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.status_code
